hebrewText: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְ/מַ֣עְלָ/ה לְ/מַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִ/שְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה

tokens.bdb: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
tokens.kjv: manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-) way.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.enLiteralWord: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.explanation: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.explanationEn: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan

tokens.bdb: properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
tokens.kjv: above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on ([idiom] very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent
tokens.kjv: consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.

tokens.bdb: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
tokens.kjv: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.

be(-head), bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get (you), go (aside), [idiom] grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, [idiom] be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without.

tokens.bdb: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
tokens.ptLiteralWord: Hades or the world of the dead
tokens.enLiteralWord: Hades or the world of the dead
tokens.explanation: Hades or the world of the dead
tokens.explanationEn: Hades or the world of the dead

tokens.bdb: downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes
tokens.kjv: beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).
